description: The template's OWN dependency automation — distinct from template/renovate.json, which is what gets STAMPED into every consumer app. This repo had none until 23/09/2026: with `requireConfig: required` on the estate runner, an unconfigured repo is skipped on every run, so the two design-system floors below sat unwatched (found in a stamped app running @poodle64/ui 2026.9.9 against a published 2026.9.17).

customManagers.description: template/frontend/package.json.jinja is real JSON wearing a .jinja extension for its scaffold interpolations elsewhere in the file; Renovate's built-in npm manager only recognises a literal package.json and never opens here. This regex manager reads the two shared design-system floors directly, so a new @poodle64/ui or @poodle64/design-tokens publish reaches this repo exactly as it reaches any consumer app — the shared packageRule below (matchPackageNames, automerge:false) already governs both by name.
